Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Kiwi players are in a huddle and then they stride out into the middle. The Australian openers, Aaron Finch and  Matthew Wade walk out to open the innings. Tim Southee is all set to operate with the new ball first up!

Right then. 185 needed for the Aussies. They would have wanted that total to be a tad bit lower but they do have a strong batting attack and they will be confident of scaling this down. The Kiwis will be gunning to come out and start off strongly with the ball. Which team takes the honors? Join us shortly for the run chase.

The star of the moment, Devon Conway is caught up for a quick chat. Conway says that it took a little bit of time to get used to the wicket as initially it was sticky but got better as the game went on. Conway says that the key is to stay positive as he feels he is at his best when he is positive. Devon feels it is all about how you react and feels lucky it came off today.

Just the start that Australia would have wanted with the ball. By the time the 4th over was completed, they had already snared 3 wickets to their name. But they lose their way in the middle overs when Conway was playing his game. They were not able to put a leash on him and his exploits have seen the Black Caps reach a huge total. Jhye Richardson was good as he scalped 2 wickets and Sams had two wickets to his name as well. Zampa was economical, even though he bowled just 3 overs.

Applause all around from the crowd for Conway as he walks back now! A brilliant batting show by Devon Conway has seen the Kiwis end up with a very strong total, even though their top order was in shambles. Kane Williamson will be glad that his young guns have fired with the bat. The Kiwis were struggling at 19/3, when the duo of Conway and Philipps came along and stitched a stand of 74 runs to steady the ship. Philipps fell and Neesham came and played a good, short cameo and added 47 runs with Devon and Conway kept going at one end and ended up with 99 to his name and helped the Kiwis with a total of 184.

Just a single and Conway finishes unbeaten on 99! Full around off, Conway slices it over cover. There is a man at the deep there and the batters can get only a single. Excellent end for New Zealand. 17 off the final over! NEW ZEALAND FINISH WITH 184/6!
FOUR! Moves to 98! Low full toss on middle, Kane overcorrects this time. Devon Conway hits it through mid-wicket and in the gap for a boundary,
SIX! Slogged away and Conway moves into the 90s! Shortish on middle, Conway slogs across the line and smokes it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Moves to 94 now.

Good awareness from Conway! Wide outside off, Santner swings but misses. Conway calls for a run straight away. Wade misses his shy at the keeper's end and they get the single. Bye signaled by the umpire.
FOUR! Just what New Zealand wanted! Short ball which is slower in pace outside off, Santner pulls it in the gap through the cow corner region for a boundary.
Full and straight on the pads, Conway glances it to mid-wicket for a single.
16 off the over. Wide outside off, Conway can just steer it to sweeper cover and keep the strike.
FOUR! Superb from Conway! Full and wide outside off, Conway slams his drive through extra cover and gets a boundary. 15 off the over so far with a ball to go.

In the air but safe! Full and wide outside off. Conway lofts it over extra cover. Stoinis runs to his right and puts a dive but he cannot get there. The Hulk does really well to stop the ball though. Saves two for his side.
SIX! Picked over the ropes! Cross seam delivery on the pads, Conway just picks his flick over the backward square leg fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Slower ball bowled into the surface but Sams misses his radar and bowls too wide outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline. Wided by the umpire.
Good running! Length ball around off, Conway strikes it away from deep point and gets a couple.
Well bowled. Yorker wide outside off. Conway looks to get bat on ball but misses. Dot balls are worth their weight in gold especially at this stage of the game.
Yorker around leg. Conway moves away from the stumps and hits it to long off and keeps the strike. 2 overs remaining, can the hosts go past 175?
Who will bowl the penultimate over? Daniel Sams, it is. His figures so far read 3-0-24-2.
Bouncer around off. Santner pulls it to long on and takes a single. Brings up the 150 for New Zealand.
Full on middle and leg. Conway moves away from the stumps and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single this time.
Full on the pad and slow. Conway glances it to the leg side and gets a couple.
FOUR! Pulled away to perfection! Shortish ball on off, Conway whacks his pull through mid-wicket and in the gap for a boundary.
Back of a length ball around off. Santner pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball around off, Santner plays it towards cover and gets a single. Jhye Richardson finishes with 2/31. Good day at the office for the returning pacer.
Change in bowling now. Kane Richardson (2-0-16-0) to bowl the 18th over!
Mitchell Santner walks out, with his blade in hand now!

OUT! CAUGHT! Jhye Richardson gets his man and wins the battle. Full and wide outside off, it is away from the arc of Neesham. The ball also shapes a bit. Neesham swings but gets an outside edge. The ball goes straight into the mitts of Matthew Wade. He takes a regulation catch and brings an end to a very good knock from James Neesham!
FOUR! Finds the gap wonderfully! Slower ball but straying on the pads. Neesham swings and gets it between short fine leg and square leg for a boundary.
Fuller, outside off, carved behind point for one now.
Full and outside off, Devon Conway skips down the track and works this one through point for a brace.
On the middle pole, flicked away to the leg side for a single.
Change in bowling. Jhye Richardson (3-0-22-1) is back on now.

FOUR! Picked the gap beautifully! Another back of a length delivery on middle, Devon Conway pulls it and this time it is in front of square on the leg side. His bottom hand comes off the bat but he still finds the gap and gets a boundary.
Good stop from Agar! Back of a length ball on middle, Conway pulls it through square leg. Agar runs with full speed to his left and stops it before the ropes with a slide. Saves two for his side.
Short ball outside off. Neesham flat-bats it to deep mid-wicket on a bounce for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Slower delivery around off, Neesham swings it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Shortish ball on middle and off, Neesham pulls it away from deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On middle, Conway plays it to long on for a single.
Length and on off, played towards point.

FOUR! Mistake from Maxwell and this will be a boundary. A slower full ball on the pads. James Neesham clips this one uppishly towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Sams runs in to his right and Maxwell runs to his left. The ball bounces before the ropes and it looks like it will be a boundary. Sams pushes the ball back and goes past the ropes. Maxwell looks to collect but instead, pushes the ball back into the ropes. Maxwell was livid with himself and so was Stoinis.
Short of a length and around off, Devon Conway guides this one towards point for a quick single.
On a good length and on middle, Devon Conway clips this one through square leg and some good running by both the batters sees them come back for the double.
Full toss around off, James Neesham slams this one to the left of the backward point region where Josh Philippe does well to move that side and stop the ball. Keeps it down to just the single.
Shortish and around leg, James swivels and pulls this one towards the fine leg region for a brace.
Floated on middle, played towards square leg. One run to end. 10 from the over.
BYE. Maxwell sees Devon looks to play the reverse sweep so he bowls this full on leg, the batter and keeper both miss. A bye as the ball goes to short fine leg.
Fired on the middle pole, full, tucked to the on side for one more single.
A brace again as James Neesham clips this one through mid-wicket again.
WIDE. Again slips this one down the leg side. Wided.
WIDE. Down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Darted on the middle pole, tucked through mid-wicket for a brace.
On middle, worked to the on side for one run.
Big Show time! Glenn Maxwell is into the attack.

FIFTY FOR DEVON CONWAY! His 3rd fifty in T20I cricket and it has come at a good time for the Kiwis! He came out when things were tough for them but has played well and will look to continue this. Length, on middle, clipped to mid-wicket for one run.
Good length around off, pushed through covers for a brace. Moves to 49 now!

EDGY...SO CLOSE! James Neesham was real close to losing his wicket now. Back of a length and around off, Neesham looks to guide this one but the ball takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps to the right of the keeper. The batters run across and exchange ends.
Short of a length and around off, pushed through point for a single.
The new man in is James Neesham!

OUT! CAUGHT! The decision to bring on Stoinis has paid rich dividends and this budding stand has been broken. Glenn goes back after scoring 30. On a length, around off, Glenn Phillips looks to work this one towards the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball loops up in the air towards the cover region and Mitchell Marsh runs in and takes a very good catch.

Short of a length and on middle, bunted towards long on. Halfway through the first run, you can hear Glenn Phillips call for two. Ashton Agar in the deep makes a mess of the collection of the ball and they take the two easily.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack now.
Around off, length, pushed to the on side.

IN THE AIR...SAFE! Glenn Phillips survives this scare now. Back of a length and around off, Phillips looks to pull but does not time it properly. It lobs towards the mid-wicket region but falls in no man's land. One run.
Length on off, pushed towards mid off for one.
FOUR! Another one! The boundaries are coming thick and fast now! Shortish and around off, pulled with power through mid-wicket.

FOUR! Into the 40s now, is Devon Conway! This is on a length and around off this time, Devon Conway plays this one smartly. Just opens up the face of his blade and steers this one through backward point and into the ropes.
Short of a length and around off, pushed back towards Kane Richardson.
Bowling change. Kane Richardson is back into the attack. 0/6 from his first over. Aaron Finch needs a wicket, can Kane break this stand?
SIX! A biggie to start, a biggie to finish. Zampa goes short, around off, Glenn Phillips goes on his back foot and hammers this one over the mid-wicket fence. 14 off this over.
Flat, around off, slashed away but the fielder at point does well to move to his left and stop the ball. No runs this time around.
Full, nice loop, on the middle pole, Devon Conway gets low and sweeps this one towards backward square leg. One run.
On middle, pushed back to Zampa.
Short, on off, pushed to the leg side for one.
SIX! SLAM! Brings up the 50-run stand with a brilliant shot! Full, tossed up, around off, Glenn Phillips stands tall and smokes this one over long on.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries to finish the over. The Kiwis are finding their groove now. Floated on middle, Conway sweeps it hard and just away from deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard! On the pads, Devon Conway gets on his knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Darted quicker on the pads, Conway tickles it to short fine leg.
Short on middle, Devon Conway punches it away from sweeper cover for a couple.
On middle, Phillips flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle, Devon flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Very full on the stumps, Glenn Phillips defends it.
SIX! Smoked away! First biggie off the game for Glenn Phillips! He is getting in his zone now. Short on middle, Glenn Phillips picks it up early and hooks it over backward square leg for a biggie.
Good shot and well fielded. Length ball outside off, Conway cuts it to the right of point. Agar there dives and pushes the ball away. Single taken.
Full on middle, Conway plays it to mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, Phillips punches it to sweeper cover and rotates the strike.
Jhye starts his new spell with a good length ball around off, Conway punches it to cover for one.
Flighted around off, Glenn Phillips drives it away from the man at sweeper cover and gets a couple to end the over. 8 off Agar's first.
Floated on middle and leg, Devon Conway flicks it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Tossed up on middle and off, Conway defends it.
FOUR! Brings out the reverse sweep to good effect. Floated on middle and off, Conway brings the reverse sweep in play and hits it through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Conway taps it back to the bowler.
Agar starts with a tossed up ball on middle, Phillips knocks it to long on for a single.
Change in bowling. Ashton Agar to roll his arm now!
Good piece of fielding from Josh Philippe at cover. Flighted on off, Glenn Phillips drives it to the right of short cover. Josh Philippe there dives and keeps it down to one.
Shortish on off, Phillips punches it to the right of the bowler but not off the meat, so a dot.
Flighted on middle, Conway glances it to square leg and gets a run.
Nicely bowled leg break on middle and off. Glenn milks it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Phillips pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Zampa starts his new spell with a shortish delivery around off. Conway punches it to cover and gets a single.
Bowling change. Adam Zampa is back on now.

Single to end the over. 6 off Kane Richardson's first over. The last ball is short on middle, Devon Conway pulls it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike. The Black Caps are at 34/3 at the end of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Beautiful timing! Length delivery around off, Conway does not look to hit it hard. He just opens the face of the bat and times it beautifully in the gap through covers for a boundary.
Another dot. Good length delivery on middle. The ball skids off the surface. Conway tucks it to the leg side of the pitch.
Phillips is off the mark. Good length ball around off, Glenn tucks it to the on side and gets a single.
Slower delivery on off. Phillips defends it to short cover.
Kane starts with a very full ball, almost a yorker on off. Glenn Phillips does well to jam it out.
Kane Richardson is into the attack now.

SIX! Whipped away wonderfully! Uses the pace well! On a length and on the pads, Conway comes down the track slightly and whips this one over the fine leg fence. Sams was the man in the deep and he tried to take it but the ball sailed over him.
Short of a length this time and around off, punched to the cover region. They think about one but do not go for it.
Length and on off, pushed to the off side.
Goes fuller now and on the pads, Devon Conway whips this one through square leg. Comes back for the second run easily.
Length and outside off, Devon Conway comes down the track and looks to push this through the off side but fails to get any bat on this.
WIDE. Shorter and down the leg side, Devon misses his pull and this is wided by the umpire.
Fuller, around off, dug out by Devon.
New Zealand in big trouble here as Glenn Phillips walks out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND CAUGHT! The big fish has been netted. Kane Williamson goes back for just 12 runs, off 13 balls. Sams strikes again and gets his 2nd wicket. Sams goes for the back of a length delivery around off, Williamson looks to hook this one away but only manages to get an inside edge, which Wade takes easily. 3 down now are the Kiwis.
FOUR! Slightly uppish but the ball still finds the ropes. Length and around off, Williamson skips down the track and pulls this one through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Sams drags his length back and bowls a shorter one around middle, Kane looks to pull but does not get any bat on this.
Almost yorker length and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off this time, played towards covers now and Kane again is loud as he says 'WAIT THERE' to Devon.
Slower and around off, pushed towards point. 'NOOOOOO', is the call by Kane, for the single.
Leg bye. Shortish and on the body, the Kiwi skipper looks to pull but misses and the ball takes his body and lobs towards the short fine leg region. A leg bye is sneaked in.
Goes fuller and on the pads, Devon clips this one to square leg for one run.
Conway is underway! Good length, around off, pushed through covers for a brace.
Short of a length and on middle, Devon pushes this one towards the leg side.
Devon Conway walks out at number 4!

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Richardson removes Tim very early on and this is a beautiful start for Australia! The second wicket is down and the Aussies are on top now. Jhye goes for a yorker length ball around off, tails back in ever-so-slightly as Tim Seifert looks to get his bat down to block. He is late into the block and the ball goes onto disturb the furniture behind.
Around off, on a length, Kane guides this one towards third man for one.
Bowling change. Jhye Richardson is into the attack.
Full, around off, played towards covers. A good start by Zampa. 4 off this over.

2 LEG BYES. Floated, on middle and leg, Tim Seifert looks to flick but misses and the ball takes the pads and goes through short third man for a couple of leg byes. An appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
On off, punched to the cover fielder.
Flat, on the pads, flicked to short fine leg for one.
On middle, pushed back to the right of Zampa and as he goes to collect, he bundles into Tim. No harm, no foul. We move on!
Zampa starts off with a full toss on middle, Tim bunts this one towards the long off region to open his account.
Who will share the new ball with Daniel Sams? Interesting from Aaron Finch as Adam Zampa is all set to operate from the other end.
Two to end. Length and outside off, slashed away through point for a couple by Kane. 6 runs and a wicket to start off the first over.
FOUR! The first runs of the game and the skipper is the one who fetches it for the Black Caps! Shorter and around off, Williamson stands tall and pulls this one through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length and around off, cut away but straight to point.
Skipper, Kane Williamson walks out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia draw first blood and Guptill goes back for a 3-ball duck. An easy take for the fielder and Sams has struck. On a length and outside off, Guptill looks to loft this one over point but only manages to give an easy catch to Agar to point. Just the start Australia would have been envisioning.
Identical to the previous delivery and Guptill offers the same kind of shot. Which is basically no shot.
Sams starts off with a length ball outside off, Martin lets this one through to the keeper.

Right then. We are done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is all set to begin. The Australian players come out and look to spread out to their respective positions out on the field. The Kiwi openers, Martin Guptill and Tim Seifert follow them out too. Daniel Sams to start off with the ball first up. Here he comes...
Time for the National Anthems now! First, it will be Australia's and that will be followed by New Zealand's.

PITCH REPORT - Craig McMillan and Suzie Bates are the pitch inspectors for the day. Craig starts by saying that it looks like a very good day for cricket. Suzie says that it is a good cricket wicket and there will be good pace and bounce and it will be good for the batters too. Ends by saying that bowlers from both sides will enjoy bowling here.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Kyle Jamieson, Tim Southee, Ish Sodhi, Trent Boult.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Matthew Wade (WK), Josh Philippe, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Mitchell Marsh, Daniel Sams, Ashton Agar, Jhye Richardson, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.

Kane Williamson, the New Zealand skipper, starts by says they wanted to bowl first too as the wicket is pretty good but they now will look to do well and execute their plans. States it is great to be back out there and they are looking forward to this game. Adds it is important for them to continue their performances against a good Australian side. Informs Bennet and Chapman are out.

The Australian skipper, Aaron Finch says that it looks like a really good wicket and he feels it won't change. Mentions the percentage of teams chasing is higher so they would want to chase but first, they want to start off well with the ball. Adds they had 12 days of training, the first few days were quite individual-based and then with the team. Informs Josh Philippe is making his debut and he is quite excited for him.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Finch. AUSTRALIA WILL BOWL FIRST!

Hello and a warm welcome to Australia's tour of New Zealand! This is a very short series as the Aussies go to their neighbors for just 5 T20Is and hence, every game of this tour promises to be a cracker. Australia lead into this series on the back of a T20I series loss against India and will be looking to bounce back here. They have chosen a relatively young squad this time around and it will be interesting to see how this team performs. The Kiwis, on the other hand, have been dominant at home, be it T20Is or Tests. Even against Pakistan, they were dominant and won the series. They too have chosen to go for a younger squad and will be hoping to continue their good run at home. Which team draws first blood? Join us as we bring you the toss and the team news.
